title: Reverse-Engineered Honeywell Fan
summary: I disassembled a commercial Honeywell fan, measured every part of the rotating system, and rebuilt it as a SolidWorks assembly with engineering drawings.
result: Rebuilt the rotating system as a five-part SolidWorks assembly with roughly 130 features across the two most complex housings.
role: Individual project for MCEN 1025 CAD & Fabrication
spec: Reconstruct a commercial product's mechanical design from the physical parts alone.
I took the fan apart and captured dimensional data with calipers and angle finders, then modeled each part and assembled them with mates that match how the real parts fit together.
A five-part assembly with roughly 130 features across the two most complex housings, plus drawings that document the mechanical architecture and assembly relationships.
